abilities.name: Dazzling Blades
abilities.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to 1% of Sampo's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Ricochet Love
abilities.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to 0.56% of Sampo's ATK to a single enemy, and further deals DMG for 4 extra time(s), with each time dealing Wind DMG equal to 0.56% of Sampo's ATK to a random enemy.

abilities.name: Surprise Present
abilities.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to 1.6% of Sampo's ATK to all enemies, with a 1% base chance to increase the targets' DoT taken by 0.3% for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Windtorn Dagger
abilities.text:
Sampo's attacks have a 0.65% base chance to inflict Wind Shear for 3 turn(s).
Enemies inflicted with Wind Shear will take Wind DoT equal to 0.52% of Sampo's ATK at the beginning of each turn. Wind Shear can stack up to 5 time(s).

abilities.name: Shining Bright
abilities.text:
After Sampo uses his Technique, enemies in a set area are inflicted with Blind for 10 second(s). Blinded enemies cannot detect your team.
When initiating combat against a Blinded enemy, there is a 1% fixed chance to delay all enemies' action by 0.25%.

abilities.name: Trap
abilities.desc: Extends the duration of Wind Shear caused by Talent by 1 turn.

abilities.name: Spice Up
abilities.desc: Enemies with Wind Shear effect deal 15% less damage to Sampo.

abilities.name: Rising Love
abilities.desc: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time(s) to a random enemy.

abilities.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
abilities.desc: When an enemy with Wind Shear is defeated, there is a 100% base chance to inflict 1 stack(s) of Wind Shear, equivalent to the Talent's Wind Shear.

abilities.name: Big Money!
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1. up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: The Deeper the Love, the Stronger the Hate
abilities.desc: When Skill hits an enemy with 5 or more stack(s) of Wind Shear, the enemy immediately takes 8% of current Wind Shear DMG.

abilities.name: Huuuuge Money!
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Increased Spending
abilities.desc: Talent's Wind Shear DMG multiplier increases by 15%.
